Desktop rerun covers categories and the five articles, without revisiting the homepage. The environment proxy denies the existing homepage YouTube thumbnail; its browser delivery remains unverified. No proxy bypass, ignored TLS errors or fabricated image response. Only advertising/Analytics SDKs use deterministic empty fixtures.

diagnostic.method: Desktop1440 ES, actual production responses through the existing managed proxy with TLS verification; advertising/Analytics SDK fixtures unchanged; no website mutations.

proxy_access_probe.method: Normal HTTPS GET with inherited proxy and TLS, outside sandbox

desktop_rerun.method: 3 desktop1440 contexts, ES/EN/FR, site JavaScript enabled: categories, five articles and a language switch for every article. Own HTTPS responses use route.fetch with the inherited managed proxy and normal CA/TLS verification. Only existing advertising/Analytics SDK fixtures are used. No homepage visits and no external YouTube thumbnail requests occur in this focused rerun. Homepage HTTP200/initial HTML was verified independently, but its external YouTube thumbnail could not be checked by this executor because the proxy rejects its CONNECT with403. The original browser report and diagnostic failure evidence are preserved; no console errors are suppressed. This test does not establish real creative delivery or monetization.

limits: Current interest signals are not Google search volume or ranking.
Neither indexing nor search positions are guaranteed.
This cloud execution does not guarantee future executor or connection availability.

The existing homepage YouTube thumbnail could not be verified in this cloud browser because its environment proxy denies i.ytimg.com (CONNECT 403). All new article images and navigation were verified; no website changes were made for this external limitation.
validation_history: The first preflight preservation check compared normalized JSON with live objects containing undefined properties; it was corrected to compare normalized catalogues. No old article changed.
The initial static check ran before the inventory was synchronized and reported the expected 191/196 mismatch. After refreshing inventory, all required static/SEO/editorial checks passed.
An initial build before batch JSON assembly reported the missing JSON import; the assembled release then built successfully.

The first strict HTTP byte comparison detected Cloudflare Pages adding its own Web Analytics tag and one newline. After pinning exactly that 367-byte injection, all 60 verified HTML documents matched the release. No other differences were ignored; sitemap, robots, ads.txt and 37 resources matched raw bytes.

The first public browser run passed all article, image and language checks but desktop console assertions found two Chromium tunnel failures per context for the existing homepage YouTube thumbnail. The environment proxy explicitly denied that external host (CONNECT 403). No bypass was attempted. The three desktop contexts were rerun successfully against categories and the five articles, which do not embed the resource. Homepage HTML remains HTTP-verified; its external video thumbnail remains unverified in this cloud browser. No website or advertising code was changed for this.
